segments.ja171:1.1: Kalyāṇadhammoti yadā janinda, loke samaññaṃ anupāpuṇāti;
segments.ja171:1.3: Tasmā na hiyyetha [hīyetha (sī.)] naro sapañño, hiriyāpi santo dhuramādiyanti.
segments.ja171:2.1: Sāyaṃ samaññā idha majja pattā, kalyāṇadhammoti janinda loke;
segments.ja171:2.3: Tāhaṃ samekkhaṃ idha pabbajissaṃ, na hi matthi chando idha kāmabhogeti.
